name: frame-debugger-pick-pixel
description: Which draw call wrote this pixel? Give a 0..1 position from a Game View screenshot (top-left origin) and it binary-searches Frame Debugger events for the one that produced the final colour there. Start here for any wrong-looking pixel instead of toggling effects.

x.description: 0..1 from the LEFT edge of the capture (px/pngWidth of a screenshot-game-view PNG).

y.description: 0..1 from the TOP edge of the capture (py/pngHeight; PNG origin is top-left).

maxDimension.description: Capture resolution cap. Defaults to 4096 (effectively native) so single-pixel detail survives; lower it to trade accuracy for speed.
